from openpyxl.styles import Font, Border, Side, Alignment

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Remove any borders on column G (entire column G)
# and ensure no values on G (already none)
thin = Side(style='thin')
header_border = Border(left=thin,right=thin,top=thin,bottom=thin)

# Headers row 4: D4,E4,F4,H4 bold and bordered. Wrap text for row 4.

for addr in header_cells:
    c = ws[addr]
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
    c.border = header_border
    c.alignment = Alignment(wrap_text=True)

# Wrap text for row 4 all cells (text in row 4) - specifically D,E,F,G,H
for col in range(4,9):
    ws.cell(4,col).alignment = Alignment(wrap_text=True)

# Also ensure no bordering on column G. Since G4 already not bordered, fine.

    cell = ws.cell(r,8)
    formula = ('=IF(AND($D{r}=5551234,OR(ROW()=26,$D{r+1}<>5551234)),'
               'ROW()-LOOKUP(2,1/($D$5:$D{r}<>5551234),ROW($D$5:$D{r})),"")').format(r=r)
    cell.value = formula
